name: StellarFoundations
author: SilentHacks
description:
Build stationary planetary bases with ground anchors and adjustable timber piers. Start a new base or anchor an existing structure without rebuilding it.

Preview for StellarDrive Demo 0.8.2. Requires MelonLoader 0.7.3 and SDModKit 1.3.3. Remote co-op is not yet qualified; multiplayer requires matching versions.
